title: Client details
description: Profile and related records. Read only. Dates use Asia/Almaty time.
contacts: Contact details come from the profile. Their verification status is not available here.

empty.campaigns: The source returned no accessible campaigns for this client.
empty.invoices: The source returned no accessible invoices for this client.

unconfigured: Administrative access to profiles is not configured
invalidId: The client ID in the URL is invalid. Return to the client list.
invalidPage: The tab or page in the URL is invalid. Open the first page of the tab.

errors.denied: The server denied access to this data. Check access permissions.

errors.unavailable: Could not retrieve data. Please try again.
